STEP 1: Write the new prisma/schema.prisma (COMPLETELY replace existing content):

```prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:dev.sqlite"
}

model Session {
  id                  String    @id
  shop                String
  state               String
  isOnline            Boolean   @default(false)
  scope               String?
  expires             DateTime?
  accessToken         String
  userId              BigInt?
  firstName           String?
  lastName            String?
  email               String?
  accountOwner        Boolean   @default(false)
  locale              String?
  collaborator        Boolean?  @default(false)
  emailVerified       Boolean?  @default(false)
  refreshToken        String?
  refreshTokenExpires DateTime?
}

model Quiz {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  title       String
  description String?
  slug        String
  status      String   @default("draft")
  type        String   @default("product-recommendation")
  settings    String   @default("{}")
  styling     String   @default("{}")
  completions Int      @default(0)
  startCount  Int      @default(0)
  publishedAt DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  questions   Question[]
  resultPages ResultPage[]
  responses   QuizResponse[]
  events      AnalyticsEvent[]

  @@unique([shop, slug])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}

model Question {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  quizId      String
  type        String
  title       String
  description String?
  imageUrl    String?
  required    Boolean  @default(true)
  position    Int      @default(0)
  settings    String   @default("{}")
  logic       String   @default("{}")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  quiz        Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  answers     Answer[]

  @@index([quizId, position])
}

model Answer {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  questionId     String
  text           String
  imageUrl       String?
  position       Int      @default(0)
  score          Int      @default(0)
  productTags    String   @default("[]")
  nextQuestionId String?
  metadata       String   @default("{}")

  question       Question @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([questionId, position])
}

model ResultPage {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  quizId        String
  title         String
  description   String?
  type          String   @default("default")
  minScore      Int?
  maxScore      Int?
  matchTags     String   @default("[]")
  productLimit  Int      @default(4)
  layout        String   @default("grid")
  showDiscount  Boolean  @default(false)
  discountType  String?
  discountValue Float?
  discountCode  String?
  ctaText       String?
  ctaUrl        String?
  styling       String   @default("{}")
  position      Int      @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  quiz          Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([quizId])
  @@index([quizId, position])
}

model QuizResponse {
  id                  String    @id @default(cuid())
  quizId              String
  shop                String
  sessionId           String
  email               String?
  answers             String    @default("[]")
  score               Int       @default(0)
  recommendedProducts String    @default("[]")
  completedAt         DateTime?
  convertedAt         DateTime?
  revenue             Float     @default(0)
  source              String    @default("embed")
  deviceType          String?
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime  @updatedAt

  quiz                Quiz      @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([quizId, shop])
  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([email])
  @@index([sessionId])
}

model ProductMapping {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  productGid  String
  title       String
  imageUrl    String?
  handle      String?
  tags        String   @default("[]")
  score       Int      @default(0)
  collections String   @default("[]")
  priceMin    Float?
  priceMax    Float?
  status      String   @default("active")
  syncedAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, productGid])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}

model QuizTemplate {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  name         String
  description  String?
  category     String
  thumbnail    String?
  templateData String   @default("{}")
  isGlobal     Boolean  @default(false)
  shop         String?
  usageCount   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([category])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([isGlobal])
}

model WidgetConfig {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop         String   @unique
  position     String   @default("embedded")
  triggerType  String   @default("button")
  triggerValue String   @default("{}")
  styling      String   @default("{}")
  branding     String   @default("{}")
  customCss    String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt
}

model EmailIntegration {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  provider  String
  apiKey    String
  listId    String?
  settings  String   @default("{}")
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, provider])
  @@index([shop])
}

model Subscription {
  id                    String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                  String    @unique
  planId                String    @default("free")
  billingInterval       String    @default("monthly")
  shopifySubscriptionId String?
  status                String    @default("active")
  trialEndsAt           DateTime?
  currentPeriodEnd      DateTime?
  quizLimit             Int       @default(1)
  responseLimit         Int       @default(100)
  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model AnalyticsEvent {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  quizId    String
  eventType String
  sessionId String
  data      String   @default("{}")
  revenue   Float    @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  quiz      Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([shop, quizId, eventType])
  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([quizId, createdAt])
  @@index([sessionId])
}
```

STEP 5: Create app/utils/helpers.ts:
```typescript
import db from "~/db.server";

export function slugify(text: string): string {
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
}

export async function generateUniqueSlug(shop: string, title: string): Promise<string> {
  const base = slugify(title) || "quiz";
  let slug = base;
  let counter = 0;
  while (await db.quiz.findFirst({ where: { shop, slug } })) {
    counter++;
    slug = `${base}-${counter}`;
  }
  return slug;
}

export function parseSafe<T>(str: string, fallback: T): T {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(str) as T;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

export function formatCurrency(amount: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD" }).format(amount);
}

export function formatDate(date: Date | string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }).format(new Date(date));
}
```

```typescript
import { z } from "zod";

export const QuizCreateSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(1, "Title is required").max(255),
  type: z.enum(["product-recommendation", "personality", "assessment", "survey", "lead-gen"]).default("product-recommendation"),
  description: z.string().max(1000).optional(),
});

export const QuizUpdateSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(1).max(255).optional(),
  description: z.string().max(1000).optional(),
  status: z.enum(["draft", "active", "paused", "archived"]).optional(),
  settings: z.string().optional(),
  styling: z.string().optional(),
});

export const QuestionCreateSchema = z.object({
  quizId: z.string().cuid(),
  type: z.enum(["multiple-choice", "image-choice", "slider", "text-input", "email", "date", "dropdown", "rating", "multiple-choice-multi"]),
  title: z.string().min(1, "Question title is required").max(500),
  description: z.string().max(1000).optional(),
  required: z.boolean().default(true),
});

export const AnswerCreateSchema = z.object({
  questionId: z.string().cuid(),
  text: z.string().min(1).max(255),
  score: z.number().int().min(-100).max(100).default(0),
  productTags: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
});
```

input.content:
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:dev.sqlite"
}

model Session {
  id                  String    @id
  shop                String
  state               String
  isOnline            Boolean   @default(false)
  scope               String?
  expires             DateTime?
  accessToken         String
  userId              BigInt?
  firstName           String?
  lastName            String?
  email               String?
  accountOwner        Boolean   @default(false)
  locale              String?
  collaborator        Boolean?  @default(false)
  emailVerified       Boolean?  @default(false)
  refreshToken        String?
  refreshTokenExpires DateTime?
}

model Quiz {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  title       String
  description String?
  slug        String
  status      String   @default("draft")
  type        String   @default("product-recommendation")
  settings    String   @default("{}")
  styling     String   @default("{}")
  completions Int      @default(0)
  startCount  Int      @default(0)
  publishedAt DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  questions   Question[]
  resultPages ResultPage[]
  responses   QuizResponse[]
  events      AnalyticsEvent[]

  @@unique([shop, slug])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}

model Question {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  quizId      String
  type        String
  title       String
  description String?
  imageUrl    String?
  required    Boolean  @default(true)
  position    Int      @default(0)
  settings    String   @default("{}")
  logic       String   @default("{}")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  quiz        Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  answers     Answer[]

  @@index([quizId, position])
}

model Answer {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  questionId     String
  text           String
  imageUrl       String?
  position       Int      @default(0)
  score          Int      @default(0)
  productTags    String   @default("[]")
  nextQuestionId String?
  metadata       String   @default("{}")

  question       Question @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([questionId, position])
}

model ResultPage {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  quizId        String
  title         String
  description   String?
  type          String   @default("default")
  minScore      Int?
  maxScore      Int?
  matchTags     String   @default("[]")
  productLimit  Int      @default(4)
  layout        String   @default("grid")
  showDiscount  Boolean  @default(false)
  discountType  String?
  discountValue Float?
  discountCode  String?
  ctaText       String?
  ctaUrl        String?
  styling       String   @default("{}")
  position      Int      @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  quiz          Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([quizId])
  @@index([quizId, position])
}

model QuizResponse {
  id                  String    @id @default(cuid())
  quizId              String
  shop                String
  sessionId           String
  email               String?
  answers             String    @default("[]")
  score               Int       @default(0)
  recommendedProducts String    @default("[]")
  completedAt         DateTime?
  convertedAt         DateTime?
  revenue             Float     @default(0)
  source              String    @default("embed")
  deviceType          String?
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime  @updatedAt

  quiz                Quiz      @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([quizId, shop])
  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([email])
  @@index([sessionId])
}

model ProductMapping {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  productGid  String
  title       String
  imageUrl    String?
  handle      String?
  tags        String   @default("[]")
  score       Int      @default(0)
  collections String   @default("[]")
  priceMin    Float?
  priceMax    Float?
  status      String   @default("active")
  syncedAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, productGid])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}

model QuizTemplate {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  name         String
  description  String?
  category     String
  thumbnail    String?
  templateData String   @default("{}")
  isGlobal     Boolean  @default(false)
  shop         String?
  usageCount   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([category])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([isGlobal])
}

model WidgetConfig {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop         String   @unique
  position     String   @default("embedded")
  triggerType  String   @default("button")
  triggerValue String   @default("{}")
  styling      String   @default("{}")
  branding     String   @default("{}")
  customCss    String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt
}

model EmailIntegration {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  provider  String
  apiKey    String
  listId    String?
  settings  String   @default("{}")
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, provider])
  @@index([shop])
}

model Subscription {
  id                    String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                  String    @unique
  planId                String    @default("free")
  billingInterval       String    @default("monthly")
  shopifySubscriptionId String?
  status                String    @default("active")
  trialEndsAt           DateTime?
  currentPeriodEnd      DateTime?
  quizLimit             Int       @default(1)
  responseLimit         Int       @default(100)
  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model AnalyticsEvent {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  quizId    String
  eventType String
  sessionId String
  data      String   @default("{}")
  revenue   Float    @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  quiz      Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([shop, quizId, eventType])
  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([quizId, createdAt])
  @@index([sessionId])
}
